from solution import find_long_word
import inspect


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Find all five characters long word as in 'Please move back to strem' -> ['strem']."""
    result = find_long_word('Please move back to strem')
    assert result == ['strem']  # len('strem')==5 kept; 6,4,4,2 excluded -> 1 item


def test_issue_single_exact_five_letter_word():
    """Find all five characters long word when text is one 5-letter word."""
    result = find_long_word('hello')
    assert result == ['hello']  # len('hello')==5 -> 1 item


def test_issue_empty_string_returns_empty():
    """Find all five characters long word in empty string gives empty list."""
    result = find_long_word('')
    assert result == []  # 0 words -> 0 items; 0 == 0


def test_issue_no_five_letter_word():
    """Find all five characters long word returns empty when no 5-letter word exists."""
    result = find_long_word('I am to go on at')
    assert result == []  # lens 1,2,2,2,2,2 -> none ==5 -> 0 items


def test_issue_multiple_mixed_lengths_filters_only_fives():
    """Find all five characters long word returns only the 5-letter words."""
    result = find_long_word('apple pie mango cake grape')
    assert result == ['apple', 'mango', 'grape']  # lens 5,3,5,4,5 -> 3 kept; 5==5


def test_issue_four_letter_word_excluded():
    """Find all five characters long word excludes words just below threshold (4 chars)."""
    result = find_long_word('move')
    assert result == []  # len('move')==4; 4<5 -> 0 items


def test_issue_six_letter_word_excluded():
    """Find all five characters long word excludes words just above threshold (6 chars)."""
    result = find_long_word('Please')
    assert result == []  # len('Please')==6; 6>5 -> 0 items


def test_issue_long_word_not_partially_matched():
    """Find all five characters long word does not match part of a longer word."""
    result = find_long_word('streaming')
    assert result == []  # len('streaming')==9; 9>5 -> 0 items, no 5-substring


def test_issue_punctuation_boundaries_still_match():
    """Find all five characters long word finds words next to punctuation."""
    result = find_long_word('Hello, world!')
    assert result == ['Hello', 'world']  # len('Hello')==5, len('world')==5 -> 2 items


def test_contract_returns_list_type():
    """Function returns a list as shown by example == ['strem']."""
    result = find_long_word('hello world')
    assert isinstance(result, list)  # type is list; 5+5 -> 2 items expected
    assert result == ['hello', 'world']  # len 5 and 5 -> 2 items


def test_contract_takes_single_text_argument():
    """Public interface is def find_long_word(text) with one parameter."""
    sig = inspect.signature(find_long_word)
    assert list(sig.parameters.keys()) == ['text']  # 1 param expected; 1==1
